before: A revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave Him to show His slaves the things that must take place soon. He made it known by sending through His angel to His slave John,
after: A revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave Him to show His slaves what must take place soon. He made it known to His slave John by sending His angel,

before: who testified to the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ, all that he saw.
after: who testified to the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ, all that he saw.

before: Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of the prophecy and keep the things written therein, for the time is near.
after: Blessed is the one who reads aloud, and blessed are those who hear the words of the prophecy and keep what is written in it, for the time is near.

before: John, to the seven Churches in Asia: grace to you and peace from the One who is and who was and who is coming, and from the seven spirits before His throne,
after: John, to the seven Churches in Asia: grace to you and peace from the One who is and who was and who is coming, and from the seven spirits before His throne,

before: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To the One who loveth us and freed us from our sins in His blood—
after: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To Him who loves us and freed us from our sins by His blood—

before: and made us a kingdom, priests to His God and Father—to Him be the glory and dominion for the ages of the ages. Amen.
after: and made us a kingdom, priests to His God and Father—to Him be the glory and dominion for the ages of the ages. Amen.

before: Behold, He is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see Him, even those who pierced Him, and all the tribes of the earth will mourn over Him. Yea, amen.
after: Behold, He is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see Him, even those who pierced Him, and all the tribes of the earth will mourn over Him. Yea, amen.

before: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” saith the Lord God, the One who is and who was and who is coming, the Almighty.
after: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, the One who is and who was and who is coming, the Almighty.

before: I, John, your brother and fellow partner in the affliction and kingdom and endurance in Jesus, came to be on the island called Patmos because of the word of God and the testimony of Jesus.
after: I, John, your brother and fellow sharer in the affliction and kingdom and endurance in Jesus, was on the island called Patmos because of the word of God and the testimony of Jesus.

before: I came to be in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet,
after: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day and heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet,

before: saying, “What thou seest, write in a scroll and send to the seven Churches: to Ephesus and to Smyrna and to Pergamum and to Thyatira and to Sardis and to Philadelphia and to Laodicea.”
after: saying, “Write what you see in a scroll and send it to the seven Churches: to Ephesus and to Smyrna and to Pergamum and to Thyatira and to Sardis and to Philadelphia and to Laodicea.”

before: And I turned to see the voice that was speaking with me, and having turned, I saw seven golden lampstands,
after: And I turned to see the voice that spoke with me. When I turned, I saw seven golden lampstands,

before: and in the midst of the lampstands One like a son of man, clothed in a robe reaching to the feet and girded around the chest with a golden belt.
after: and in the midst of the lampstands One like a son of man, clothed in a robe reaching to the feet and girded around the chest with a golden belt.

before: And His head and hair were white like white wool, like snow, and His eyes like a flame of fire,
after: And His head and hair were white like white wool, like snow, and His eyes like a flame of fire,

before: and His feet like burnished bronze, as refined in a furnace, and His voice like the sound of many waters.
after: and His feet like burnished bronze, as though made to glow in a furnace, and His voice like the sound of many waters.

before: And He held seven stars in His right hand, and from His mouth a sharp two-edged sword was coming out, and His appearance was like the sun shining in its strength.
after: And He held seven stars in His right hand, and from His mouth a sharp two-edged sword was coming out, and His appearance was like the sun shining in its strength.

before: And when I saw Him, I fell at His feet as dead. And He placed His right hand upon me, saying, “Fear not. I am the first and the last,
after: And when I saw Him, I fell at His feet as dead. And He placed His right hand upon me, saying, “Fear not. I am the first and the last,

before: and the living One. I became dead, and behold, I am living for the ages of the ages, and I have the keys of death and Hades.
after: and the Living One. I was dead, and behold, I am alive for the ages of the ages, and I have the keys of death and Hades.

before: Therefore write the things thou sawest, and the things that are, and the things that are to take place after these.
after: Therefore write what you saw, and what is, and what is to take place after these things.

before: The mystery of the seven stars thou sawest upon My right hand, and the seven golden lampstands: the seven stars are angels of the seven Churches, and the seven lampstands are seven Churches.”
after: As for the mystery of the seven stars you saw upon My right hand, and the seven golden lampstands: the seven stars are angels of the seven Churches, and the seven lampstands are seven Churches.”

before: “To the angel of the Church in Ephesus write: These things saith the One who holdeth the seven stars in His right hand, who walketh in the midst of the seven golden lampstands:
after: “To the angel of the Church in Ephesus write: Thus says the One who holds the seven stars in His right hand, who walks in the midst of the seven golden lampstands:

before: ‘I know thy works, and the labour and thine endurance, and that thou canst not bear evil people; and thou didst test those who call themselves apostles and are not, and didst find them false.
after: ‘I know your works and your labor and endurance, and that you cannot bear evil people. You tested those who call themselves apostles and are not, and found them false.

before: And thou hast endurance and didst bear up for My name’s sake, and hast not grown weary.
after: You have endurance, and you have borne up for My name’s sake and have not grown weary.

before: But I have this against thee: thou didst abandon thy first love.
after: But I have this against you: you abandoned your first love.

before: Therefore remember from whence thou hast fallen, and repent and do the first works. Otherwise I am coming to thee and will move thy lampstand from its place, unless thou repent.
after: Remember, therefore, from where you have fallen. Repent and do the works you did at first. Otherwise I am coming to you and will move your lampstand from its place, unless you repent.

before: But this thou hast: thou hatest the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
after: Yet this you have: you hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.

before: Let the one who hath an ear hear what the Spirit saith to the Churches. To the one who conquereth I will give to eat from the tree of life, which is in the Paradise of God.’
after: Let the one who has an ear hear what the Spirit says to the Churches. To the one who conquers I will give to eat from the tree of life, which is in the Paradise of God.’

before: And to the angel of the Church in Smyrna write: These things saith the first and the last, who became dead and lived:
after: And to the angel of the Church in Smyrna write: Thus says the First and the Last, who was dead and came to life:

before: ‘I know thine affliction and poverty—but thou art rich—and the slander from those who say that they themselves are Jews and are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.
after: ‘I know your affliction and poverty—but you are rich—and the slander from those who say they are Jews and are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.

before: Fear none of the things thou art about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that ye may be tested, and ye shall have affliction for ten days. Become faithful until death, and I will give thee the crown of life.
after: Fear none of what you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison so that you may be tested, and you will have affliction for ten days. Be faithful unto death, and I will give you the crown of life.

before: Let the one who hath an ear hear what the Spirit saith to the Churches. The one who conquereth shall certainly not be harmed by the second death.’
after: Let the one who has an ear hear what the Spirit says to the Churches. The one who conquers will never be harmed by the second death.’

before: And to the angel of the Church in Pergamum write: These things saith the One who hath the sharp two-edged sword:
after: And to the angel of the Church in Pergamum write: Thus says the One who has the sharp two-edged sword:

before: ‘I know where thou dwellest, where Satan’s throne is, and thou holdest fast My name and didst not deny My faith, even in the days of Antipas, My witness, My faithful one, who was killed among you, where Satan dwelleth.
after: ‘I know where you dwell, where Satan’s throne is. You hold fast My name and did not deny My faith, even in the days of Antipas, My witness, My faithful one, who was killed among you, where Satan dwells.

before: But I have a few things against thee: thou hast there those who hold the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to put a stumbling block before the sons of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols and to commit sexual immorality.
after: But I have a few things against you: you have there those who hold the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to set a stumbling block before the sons of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols and to commit fornication.

before: So thou also hast those who hold the teaching of the Nicolaitans in the same way.
after: So you too have those who hold the teaching of the Nicolaitans in the same way.

before: Therefore repent. Otherwise I am coming to thee quickly and will wage war against them with the sword of My mouth.
after: Repent, therefore. Otherwise I am coming to you quickly, and I will wage war against them with the sword of My mouth.

before: Let the one who hath an ear hear what the Spirit saith to the Churches. To the one who conquereth I will give some of the hidden manna, and I will give him a white stone, and upon the stone a new name written, which no one knoweth except the one who receiveth it.’
after: Let the one who has an ear hear what the Spirit says to the Churches. To the one who conquers I will give some of the hidden manna, and I will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written, which no one knows except the one who receives it.’

before: And to the angel of the Church in Thyatira write: These things saith the Son of God, who hath His eyes like a flame of fire, and His feet like burnished bronze:
after: And to the angel of the Church in Thyatira write: Thus says the Son of God, whose eyes are like a flame of fire and whose feet are like burnished bronze:

before: ‘I know thy works and love and faith and service and thine endurance, and thy last works are more than the first.
after: ‘I know your works and your love and faith and service and endurance, and that your latter works exceed the first.

before: But I have this against thee: thou allowest the woman Jezebel, who calleth herself a prophetess, and she teacheth and deceiveth My slaves to commit sexual immorality and eat things sacrificed to idols.
after: But I have this against you: you tolerate the woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess. She teaches and leads My slaves astray to commit fornication and to eat things sacrificed to idols.

before: And I gave her time to repent, and she doth not wish to repent of her sexual immorality.
after: I gave her time to repent, and she does not wish to repent of her fornication.

before: Behold, I am throwing her into a bed, and those committing adultery with her into great affliction, unless they repent of her works.
after: Behold, I am casting her onto a bed, and those who commit adultery with her into great affliction, unless they repent of her works.

before: And I will kill her children with death, and all the Churches will know that I am the One who searcheth kidneys and hearts, and I will give to each of you according to your works.
after: And I will kill her children with death, and all the Churches will know that I am the One who searches kidneys and hearts, and I will give to each of you according to your works.

before: But to you, the rest in Thyatira, as many as do not have this teaching, who have not known the deep things of Satan, as they say, I say: I place no other burden upon you.
after: But to you, the rest in Thyatira, who do not hold this teaching and have not known the deep things of Satan, as they say, I say: I lay no other burden upon you.

before: Only hold fast what ye have until I come.
after: Only hold fast what you have until I come.

before: And to the one who conquereth and keepeth My works until the end, I will give authority over the nations,
after: To the one who conquers and keeps My works to the end, I will give authority over the nations,

before: and he will shepherd them with an iron rod, as vessels of pottery are shattered,
after: and he will shepherd them with an iron rod, as vessels of pottery are shattered,

before: as I also have received from My Father; and I will give him the morning star.
after: as I also have received from My Father; and I will give him the morning star.

before: Let the one who hath an ear hear what the Spirit saith to the Churches.’
after: Let the one who has an ear hear what the Spirit says to the Churches.’

before: And to the angel of the Church in Sardis write: These things saith the One who hath the seven spirits of God and the seven stars: ‘I know thy works, that thou hast a name that thou livest, and thou art dead.
after: And to the angel of the Church in Sardis write: Thus says the One who has the seven spirits of God and the seven stars: ‘I know your works. You have a name for being alive, yet you are dead.

before: Become watchful, and strengthen the things remaining that were about to die, for I have not found thy works fulfilled before My God.
after: Be watchful, and strengthen what remains and was about to die, for I have not found your works complete before My God.

before: Therefore remember how thou hast received and heard, and keep it and repent. Therefore if thou watch not, I will come like a thief, and thou shalt certainly not know at what hour I will come upon thee.
after: Remember, therefore, how you received and heard, and keep it and repent. If, then, you do not watch, I will come like a thief, and you will certainly not know at what hour I will come upon you.

before: But thou hast a few names in Sardis who did not defile their garments, and they shall walk with Me in white, because they are worthy.
after: But you have a few names in Sardis who did not defile their garments, and they will walk with Me in white, for they are worthy.

before: The one who conquereth will thus be clothed in white garments, and I will certainly not erase his name from the book of life, and I will confess his name before My Father and before His angels.
after: The one who conquers will thus be clothed in white garments, and I will never blot his name out of the book of life. I will confess his name before My Father and before His angels.

before: Let the one who hath an ear hear what the Spirit saith to the Churches.’
after: Let the one who has an ear hear what the Spirit says to the Churches.’

before: And to the angel of the Church in Philadelphia write: These things saith the Holy One, the True One, the One who hath the key of David, who openeth and no one will shut, and shutteth and no one openeth:
after: And to the angel of the Church in Philadelphia write: Thus says the Holy One, the True One, who has the key of David, who opens and no one will shut, and who shuts and no one opens:

before: ‘I know thy works. Behold, I have placed before thee an opened door, which no one can shut, because thou hast little strength and didst keep My word and didst not deny My name.
after: ‘I know your works. Behold, I have set before you an open door that no one can shut, because you have little strength and you kept My word and did not deny My name.

before: Behold, I give some from the synagogue of Satan, those who say that they themselves are Jews and are not, but lie. Behold, I will make them come and bow before thy feet, and know that I loved thee.
after: Behold, I give some from the synagogue of Satan, from those who say they are Jews and are not, but lie. Behold, I will make them come and bow down before your feet and know that I have loved you.

before: Because thou didst keep the word of My endurance, I also will keep thee from the hour of trial that is about to come upon the whole inhabited world, to try those dwelling upon the earth.
after: Because you kept the word of My endurance, I also will keep you from the hour of trial that is about to come upon the whole inhabited world, to try those who dwell upon the earth.

before: I am coming quickly. Hold fast what thou hast, that no one may take thy crown.
after: I am coming quickly. Hold fast what you have, that no one may take your crown.

before: The one who conquereth, I will make him a pillar in the temple of My God, and he shall certainly go outside no more. And I will write upon him the name of My God and the name of the city of My God, the new Jerusalem, which cometh down out of heaven from My God, and My new name.
after: The one who conquers, I will make him a pillar in the sanctuary of My God, and he will never go out again. I will write upon him the name of My God and the name of the city of My God, the new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from My God, and My new name.

before: Let the one who hath an ear hear what the Spirit saith to the Churches.’
after: Let the one who has an ear hear what the Spirit says to the Churches.’

before: And to the angel of the Church in Laodicea write: These things saith the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of God’s creation:
after: And to the angel of the Church in Laodicea write: Thus says the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of God’s creation:

before: ‘I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot. Would that thou wert cold or hot.
after: ‘I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. Would that you were cold or hot!

before: So because thou art lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I am about to vomit thee out of My mouth.
after: So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I am about to vomit you out of My mouth.

before: Because thou sayest, “I am rich and have become wealthy and need nothing,” and knowest not that thou art the wretched and pitiable and poor and blind and naked one,
after: Because you say, “I am rich, I have grown wealthy, and I need nothing,” and do not know that you are the one who is wretched and pitiable and poor and blind and naked,

before: I counsel thee to buy from Me gold refined by fire, that thou mayest become rich, and white garments, that thou mayest clothe thyself and the shame of thy nakedness may not be manifested, and eye salve to anoint thine eyes, that thou mayest see.
after: I counsel you to buy from Me gold refined by fire, that you may be rich, and white garments, that you may clothe yourself and the shame of your nakedness may not be seen, and salve to anoint your eyes, that you may see.

before: As many as I love, I reprove and discipline. Therefore be zealous and repent.
after: Those whom I love, I reprove and discipline. Be zealous, therefore, and repent.

before: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hear My voice and open the door, I will come in unto him and dine with him, and he with Me.
after: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in to him and dine with him, and he with Me.

before: The one who conquereth, I will give him to sit with Me on My throne, as I also conquered and sat with My Father on His throne.
after: I will grant the one who conquers to sit with Me on My throne, as I also conquered and sat with My Father on His throne.

before: Let the one who hath an ear hear what the Spirit saith to the Churches.’”
after: Let the one who has an ear hear what the Spirit says to the Churches.’”

before: After these things I saw, and behold, a door opened in heaven, and the first voice I heard like a trumpet speaking with me said, “Come up hither, and I will show thee what must take place after these things.”
after: After these things I saw, and behold, a door stood open in heaven. The first voice I had heard, like a trumpet speaking with me, said, “Come up here, and I will show you what must take place after these things.”

before: immediately I came to be in the Spirit; and behold, a throne was set in heaven, and One sitting upon the throne.
after: At once I was in the Spirit. And behold, a throne stood in heaven, and upon the throne sat One.

before: And the One sitting was in appearance like a jasper stone and a sardius, and a rainbow around the throne was in appearance like an emerald.
after: And the One seated there was in appearance like jasper and sardius, and around the throne was a rainbow like an emerald in appearance.

before: And around the throne were twenty-four thrones, and upon the thrones twenty-four elders sitting, clothed in white garments, and upon their heads golden crowns.
after: And around the throne were twenty-four thrones, and upon them sat twenty-four elders clothed in white garments, with golden crowns upon their heads.

before: And from the throne come out lightnings and voices and thunders; and seven lamps of fire burn before the throne, which are the seven spirits of God.
after: And from the throne come flashes of lightning and voices and peals of thunder, and before the throne burn seven fiery torches, which are the seven spirits of God.

before: And before the throne was something like a glassy sea, like crystal. And in the midst of the throne and around the throne were four living creatures, full of eyes in front and behind.
after: And before the throne was something like a sea of glass, like crystal. And in the midst of the throne and around the throne were four living creatures, full of eyes in front and behind.

before: And the first living creature was like a lion, and the second living creature like a calf, and the third living creature had a face like a human being’s, and the fourth living creature was like an eagle flying.
after: And the first living creature was like a lion, and the second living creature like a calf, and the third living creature had a face like a human being’s, and the fourth living creature was like an eagle flying.

before: And the four living creatures, each one of them having six wings, are full of eyes around and within; and they have no rest day and night, saying, “Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, the One who was and who is and who is coming.”
after: And the four living creatures each have six wings and are full of eyes all around and within. Day and night they have no rest, saying, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty, the One who was and who is and who is coming.”

before: And whenever the living creatures give glory and honour and thanksgiving to the One sitting upon the throne, the One living for the ages of the ages,
after: And whenever the living creatures give glory and honor and thanksgiving to the One seated upon the throne, who lives for the ages of the ages,

before: the twenty-four elders will fall before the One sitting upon the throne, and will worship the One living for the ages of the ages, and will throw their crowns before the throne, saying,
after: the twenty-four elders will fall before the One seated upon the throne and will worship Him who lives for the ages of the ages. They will cast their crowns before the throne, saying,

before: “Thou art worthy, our Lord and God, to receive the glory and the honour and the power, because Thou didst create all things, and because of Thy will they existed and were created.”
after: “Thou art worthy, our Lord and God, to receive the glory and the honor and the power, for Thou didst create all things, and because of Thy will they existed and were created.”

before: And I saw upon the right hand of the One sitting upon the throne a scroll written within and on the back, sealed with seven seals.
after: And I saw upon the right hand of the One seated upon the throne a scroll written within and on the back, sealed with seven seals.

before: And I saw a mighty angel proclaiming in a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the scroll and loose its seals?”
after: And I saw a mighty angel proclaiming with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the scroll and undo its seals?”

before: And no one in heaven or upon the earth or beneath the earth was able to open the scroll or look at it.
after: And no one in heaven or upon the earth or beneath the earth was able to open the scroll or look at it.

before: And I wept much, because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look at it.
after: And I wept much, because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look at it.

before: And one of the elders saith unto me, “Weep not. Behold, the Lion from the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, conquered, to open the scroll and its seven seals.”
after: And one of the elders says to me, “Weep not. Behold, the Lion from the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has conquered so as to open the scroll and its seven seals.”

before: And I saw in the midst of the throne and the four living creatures, and in the midst of the elders, a Lamb standing as slaughtered, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God sent into all the earth.
after: And I saw, in the midst of the throne and the four living creatures and in the midst of the elders, a Lamb standing as though slaughtered, with seven horns and seven eyes. These eyes are the seven spirits of God sent into all the earth.

before: And He came and hath taken it from the right hand of the One sitting upon the throne.
after: And He came and took the scroll from the right hand of the One seated upon the throne.

before: And when He took the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell before the Lamb, each having a lyre and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.
after: And when He took the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell before the Lamb, each having a lyre and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.

before: And they sing a new song, saying, “Thou art worthy to take the scroll and open its seals, because Thou wast slaughtered and didst purchase for God in Thy blood people from every tribe and tongue and people and nation,
after: And they sing a new song, saying, “Thou art worthy to take the scroll and open its seals, for Thou wast slaughtered and didst purchase for God by Thy blood people from every tribe and tongue and people and nation,

before: and Thou didst make them a kingdom and priests unto our God, and they shall reign upon the earth.”
after: and Thou didst make them a kingdom and priests to our God, and they will reign upon the earth.”

before: And I saw, and heard a voice of many angels around the throne and the living creatures and the elders; and their number was myriads of myriads and thousands of thousands,
after: And I saw, and I heard the voice of many angels around the throne and the living creatures and the elders. Their number was myriads of myriads and thousands of thousands,

before: saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who was slaughtered to receive the power and wealth and wisdom and strength and honour and glory and blessing.”
after: saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who was slaughtered to receive the power and wealth and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and blessing.”

before: And every creature in heaven and upon the earth and beneath the earth and upon the sea, and all the things in them, I heard saying, “To the One sitting upon the throne and to the Lamb be the blessing and the honour and the glory and the dominion for the ages of the ages.”
after: And I heard every creature in heaven and upon the earth and beneath the earth and upon the sea, and all things in them, saying, “To the One seated upon the throne and to the Lamb be the blessing and the honor and the glory and the dominion for the ages of the ages.”

before: And the four living creatures were saying, “Amen.” And the elders fell and worshipped.
after: And the four living creatures were saying, “Amen.” And the elders fell and worshiped.

before: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying as with a voice of thunder, “Come.”
after: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures say with a voice like thunder, “Come.”

before: And I saw, and behold, a white horse, and the one sitting upon it had a bow, and a crown was given to him; and he went out conquering and to conquer.
after: And I saw, and behold, a white horse. The one seated upon it had a bow, and a crown was given to him. He went out conquering and to conquer.

before: And when He opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, “Come.”
after: And when He opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, “Come.”

before: And another horse went out, fiery red, and the one sitting upon it was given to take peace from the earth, so that they would slaughter one another; and a great sword was given to him.
after: And another horse went out, fiery red. Its rider was permitted to take peace from the earth, so that people would slaughter one another. And a great sword was given to him.

before: And when He opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, “Come.” And I saw, and behold, a black horse, and the one sitting upon it had a balance in his hand.
after: And when He opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, “Come.” And I saw, and behold, a black horse, and the one seated upon it had a pair of scales in his hand.

before: And I heard something like a voice in the midst of the four living creatures saying, “A choenix of wheat for a denarius, and three choenices of barley for a denarius; and do not harm the oil and the wine.”
after: And I heard something like a voice in the midst of the four living creatures saying, “A choenix of wheat for a denarius, and three choenices of barley for a denarius; and do not harm the oil and the wine.”

before: And when He opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature saying, “Come.”
after: And when He opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature saying, “Come.”

before: And I saw, and behold, a pale green horse, and the one sitting upon it had the name Death, and Hades followed with him. And authority was given to them over a fourth of the earth, to kill with sword and with famine and with death and by the beasts of the earth.
after: And I saw, and behold, a pale green horse. The name of the one seated upon it was Death, and Hades followed with him. And authority was given to them over a fourth of the earth, to kill with sword and with famine and with death and by the wild beasts of the earth.

before: And when He opened the fifth seal, I saw beneath the altar the souls of those slaughtered because of the word of God and because of the testimony they held.
after: And when He opened the fifth seal, I saw beneath the altar the souls of those slaughtered because of the word of God and because of the testimony they held.

before: And they cried with a loud voice, saying, “How long, O Master, holy and true, before Thou dost judge and avenge our blood upon those dwelling on the earth?”
after: And they cried with a loud voice, saying, “How long, O Master, holy and true, before Thou dost judge and avenge our blood upon those who dwell on the earth?”

before: And a white robe was given to each of them, and they were told to rest for a little time yet, until their fellow slaves and their brothers, who were about to be killed as they themselves had been, were also complete in number.
after: And a white robe was given to each of them, and they were told to rest a little while longer, until their fellow slaves and their brothers, who were to be killed as they had been, were also complete in number.

before: And I saw when He opened the sixth seal, and a great earthquake occurred, and the sun became black like a haircloth sack, and the whole moon became like blood,
after: And I saw when He opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake, and the sun became black like sackcloth of hair, and the whole moon became like blood,

before: and the stars of heaven fell to the earth, as a fig tree throweth off its unripe figs when shaken by a great wind.
after: and the stars of heaven fell to the earth, as a fig tree shaken by a mighty wind casts off its unripe figs.

before: And heaven withdrew like a scroll being rolled up, and every mountain and island were moved from their places.
after: And heaven withdrew like a scroll being rolled up, and every mountain and island was moved from its place.

before: And the kings of the earth and the great ones and the commanders of thousands and the rich and the strong and every slave and free person hid themselves in the caves and among the rocks of the mountains.
after: And the kings of the earth and the great ones and the commanders of thousands and the rich and the strong and every slave and free person hid themselves in the caves and among the rocks of the mountains.

before: And they say to the mountains and the rocks, “Fall upon us and hide us from the face of the One sitting upon the throne and from the wrath of the Lamb,
after: And they say to the mountains and the rocks, “Fall upon us and hide us from the face of the One seated upon the throne and from the wrath of the Lamb,

before: because the great day of Their wrath hath come, and who is able to stand?”
after: for the great day of Their wrath has come, and who is able to stand?”

before: After this I saw four angels standing upon the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, so that no wind might blow upon the earth or upon the sea or upon any tree.
after: After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding back the four winds of the earth, so that no wind might blow upon the earth or upon the sea or upon any tree.

before: And I saw another angel coming up from the rising of the sun, having a seal of the living God, and he cried with a loud voice to the four angels who were given to harm the earth and the sea,
after: And I saw another angel ascending from the rising of the sun with a seal of the living God, and he cried with a loud voice to the four angels who had been given power to harm the earth and the sea,

before: saying, “Do not harm the earth or the sea or the trees until we seal the slaves of our God upon their foreheads.”
after: saying, “Do not harm the earth or the sea or the trees until we seal the slaves of our God upon their foreheads.”

before: And I heard the number of those sealed: a hundred forty-four thousand, sealed from every tribe of the sons of Israel.
after: And I heard the number of those sealed: a hundred forty-four thousand, sealed from every tribe of the sons of Israel.

before: From the tribe of Judah, twelve thousand sealed; from the tribe of Reuben, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Gad, twelve thousand;
after: From the tribe of Judah, twelve thousand sealed; from the tribe of Reuben, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Gad, twelve thousand;

before: from the tribe of Asher, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Naphtali, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Manasseh, twelve thousand;
after: from the tribe of Asher, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Naphtali, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Manasseh, twelve thousand;

before: from the tribe of Simeon, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Levi, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Issachar, twelve thousand;
after: from the tribe of Simeon, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Levi, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Issachar, twelve thousand;

before: from the tribe of Zebulun, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Joseph, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Benjamin, twelve thousand sealed.
after: from the tribe of Zebulun, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Joseph, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Benjamin, twelve thousand sealed.

before: After these things I saw, and behold, a great multitude that no one could number, from every nation and tribes and peoples and tongues, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, clothed in white robes, and palm branches in their hands.
after: After these things I saw, and behold, a great multitude that no one could number, from every nation and from tribes and peoples and tongues. They stood before the throne and before the Lamb, clothed in white robes, with palm branches in their hands.

before: And they cry with a loud voice, saying, “Salvation belongeth to our God, the One sitting upon the throne, and to the Lamb.”
after: And they cry with a loud voice, saying, “Salvation belongs to our God, who sits upon the throne, and to the Lamb.”

before: And all the angels were standing around the throne and the elders and the four living creatures, and fell upon their faces before the throne and worshipped God,
after: And all the angels stood around the throne and the elders and the four living creatures. They fell upon their faces before the throne and worshiped God,

before: saying, “Amen. The blessing and the glory and the wisdom and the thanksgiving and the honour and the power and the strength belong to our God for the ages of the ages. Amen.”
after: saying, “Amen. The blessing and the glory and the wisdom and the thanksgiving and the honor and the power and the strength belong to our God for the ages of the ages. Amen.”

before: And one of the elders answered, saying to me, “These who are clothed in the white robes, who are they, and from where did they come?”
after: And one of the elders answered, saying to me, “Who are these clothed in white robes, and from where did they come?”

before: And I said to him, “My lord, thou knowest.” And he said unto me, “These are they who are coming out of the great tribulation, and they washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
after: And I said to him, “My lord, you know.” And he said to me, “These are they who are coming out of the great tribulation. They washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.

before: For this reason they are before the throne of God, and serve Him day and night in His temple, and the One sitting upon the throne will spread His tent over them.
after: For this reason they are before the throne of God and serve Him day and night in His sanctuary. And the One seated upon the throne will spread His tent over them.

before: They will hunger no more or thirst any more, nor will the sun fall upon them, nor any burning heat,
after: They will hunger no more, nor thirst any more. The sun will not beat upon them, nor any scorching heat,

before: because the Lamb in the midst of the throne will shepherd them and guide them to springs of waters of life; and God will wipe every tear from their eyes.”
after: for the Lamb in the midst of the throne will shepherd them and guide them to springs of life’s waters, and God will wipe every tear from their eyes.”

before: And when He opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
after: And when He opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.

before: And I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.
after: And I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.

before: And another angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer, and much incense was given to him to offer with the prayers of all the saints upon the golden altar before the throne.
after: And another angel came and stood at the altar with a golden censer. He was given much incense to offer with the prayers of all the saints upon the golden altar before the throne.

before: And the smoke of the incense went up with the prayers of the saints from the angel’s hand before God.
after: And the smoke of the incense rose with the prayers of the saints, from the angel’s hand before God.

before: And the angel took the censer and filled it from the fire of the altar, and threw it to the earth; and there were thunders and voices and lightnings and an earthquake.
after: And the angel took the censer, filled it from the fire of the altar and cast it upon the earth. Then came thunders and voices and flashes of lightning and an earthquake.

before: And the seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound them.
after: And the seven angels who had the seven trumpets made ready to sound them.

before: And the first sounded, and there came hail and fire mixed with blood, and it was thrown to the earth; and a third of the earth was burned up, and a third of the trees was burned up, and all green grass was burned up.
after: And the first sounded. Hail and fire came, mingled with blood, and it was cast upon the earth. A third of the earth was burned up, and a third of the trees was burned up, and all green grass was burned up.

before: And the second angel sounded, and something like a great mountain burning with fire was thrown into the sea; and a third of the sea became blood,
after: And the second angel sounded. Something like a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea, and a third of the sea became blood,

before: and a third of the creatures in the sea, those having life, died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
after: and a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.

before: And the third angel sounded, and a great star fell from heaven, burning like a lamp, and fell upon a third of the rivers and upon the springs of the waters.
after: And the third angel sounded. A great star fell from heaven, burning like a torch, and fell upon a third of the rivers and upon the springs of water.

before: And the name of the star is called Wormwood; and a third of the waters became wormwood, and many people died from the waters because they were made bitter.
after: And the name of the star is Wormwood. A third of the waters became wormwood, and many people died from the waters, for they had been made bitter.

before: And the fourth angel sounded, and a third of the sun and a third of the moon and a third of the stars were struck, so that a third of them might be darkened and the day might not shine for a third of it, and the night likewise.
after: And the fourth angel sounded. A third of the sun and a third of the moon and a third of the stars were struck, so that a third of them might be darkened, and the day might not shine for a third of its span, and the night likewise.

before: And I saw, and heard one eagle flying in midheaven saying with a loud voice, “Woe, woe, woe to those dwelling upon the earth, because of the remaining voices of the trumpet of the three angels who are about to sound!”
after: And I saw and heard one eagle flying in midheaven, saying with a loud voice, “Woe, woe, woe to those who dwell upon the earth, because of the trumpet blasts still to come from the three angels who are about to sound!”

before: And the fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star fallen from heaven to the earth, and the key of the shaft of the abyss was given to him.
after: And the fifth angel sounded. I saw a star that had fallen from heaven to the earth, and the key to the shaft of the abyss was given to him.

before: And he opened the shaft of the abyss, and smoke went up from the shaft like smoke of a great furnace, and the sun and the air were darkened from the smoke of the shaft.
after: And he opened the shaft of the abyss. Smoke rose from the shaft like the smoke of a great furnace, and the sun and the air were darkened by the smoke of the shaft.

before: And from the smoke locusts went out to the earth, and authority was given to them as the scorpions of the earth have authority.
after: And from the smoke locusts went out to the earth, and authority was given to them as the scorpions of the earth have authority.

before: And they were told not to harm the grass of the earth or any green thing or any tree, but only the people who do not have the seal of God upon their foreheads.
after: And they were told not to harm the grass of the earth or any green thing or any tree, but only the people who do not have the seal of God upon their foreheads.

before: And it was given to them not to kill them, but that they should be tormented for five months; and their torment was like the torment of a scorpion when it striketh a human being.
after: And they were given leave, not to kill the people, but for the people to be tormented for five months. Their torment was like the torment of a scorpion when it strikes a person.

before: And in those days people will seek death and will certainly not find it, and will desire to die, and death fleeth from them.
after: And in those days people will seek death and will by no means find it. They will long to die, and death flees from them.

before: And the likenesses of the locusts were like horses prepared for war, and upon their heads were things like crowns resembling gold, and their faces were like human faces,
after: And the locusts in appearance were like horses prepared for war. Upon their heads were what looked like crowns resembling gold, and their faces were like human faces,

before: and they had hair like women’s hair, and their teeth were like lions’ teeth,
after: and they had hair like women’s hair, and their teeth were like lions’ teeth,

before: and they had breastplates like iron breastplates, and the sound of their wings was like the sound of chariots of many horses running to war.
after: and they had breastplates like iron breastplates, and the sound of their wings was like the sound of chariots of many horses running to war.

before: And they have tails like scorpions and stings, and in their tails is their authority to harm people for five months.
after: And they have tails like scorpions’ tails, and stings. In their tails is their authority to harm people for five months.

before: They have as king over them the angel of the abyss. His name in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in Greek he hath the name Apollyon.
after: They have as king over them the angel of the abyss. His name in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in Greek he bears the name Apollyon.

before: The one woe hath passed. Behold, two woes are still coming after these things.
after: The first woe has passed. Behold, two woes are still to come after these things.

before: And the sixth angel sounded, and I heard one voice from the horns of the golden altar before God,
after: And the sixth angel sounded, and I heard one voice from the four horns of the golden altar before God,

before: saying to the sixth angel, the one who hath the trumpet, “Loose the four angels bound at the great river Euphrates.”
after: saying to the sixth angel, who had the trumpet, “Loose the four angels bound at the great river Euphrates.”

before: And the four angels prepared for the hour and day and month and year were loosed, so that they might kill a third of the people.
after: And the four angels prepared for the hour and day and month and year were loosed, so that they might kill a third of the people.

before: And the number of the armies of the cavalry was two myriads of myriads; I heard their number.
after: And the number of the mounted armies was twice ten thousand times ten thousand. I heard their number.

before: And thus I saw the horses in the vision and those sitting upon them, having breastplates of fiery red and hyacinth blue and sulfur yellow; and the heads of the horses were like lions’ heads, and from their mouths come out fire and smoke and sulfur.
after: And thus I saw the horses in the vision and those seated upon them, with breastplates of fiery red and hyacinth blue and sulfur yellow. The heads of the horses were like lions’ heads, and out of their mouths come fire and smoke and sulfur.

before: From these three plagues a third of the people were killed: from the fire and the smoke and the sulfur coming out of their mouths.
after: By these three plagues a third of the people were killed, by the fire and the smoke and the sulfur coming out of their mouths.

before: For the authority of the horses is in their mouths and in their tails, for their tails are like snakes, having heads, and with them they harm.
after: For the authority of the horses is in their mouths and in their tails. Their tails are like serpents with heads, and with them they do harm.

before: And the rest of the people, who were not killed by these plagues, did not even repent of the works of their hands, so as not to worship the demons and the idols of gold and silver and bronze and stone and wood, which can neither see nor hear nor walk.
after: And the rest of the people, who were not killed by these plagues, did not even repent of the works of their hands. They did not cease to worship demons and idols of gold and silver and bronze and stone and wood, which can neither see nor hear nor walk.

before: And they did not repent of their murders or their sorcerous potions or their sexual immorality or their thefts.
after: And they did not repent of their murders, nor of their sorcerous potions, nor of their fornication, nor of their thefts.

before: And I saw another mighty angel coming down from heaven, clothed with a cloud, and the rainbow upon his head, and his face like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire.
after: And I saw another mighty angel coming down from heaven, clothed in a cloud, with the rainbow upon his head. His face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire,

before: And he had in his hand a little scroll opened. And he placed his right foot upon the sea and his left upon the earth,
after: and he held a little scroll open in his hand. He set his right foot upon the sea and his left upon the earth,

before: and cried with a loud voice just as a lion roareth. And when he cried, the seven thunders spoke their own voices.
after: and cried out with a loud voice, as a lion roars. And when he cried out, the seven thunders spoke with their own voices.

before: And when the seven thunders spoke, I was about to write; and I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Seal up what the seven thunders spoke, and do not write it.”
after: And when the seven thunders spoke, I was about to write. Then I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Seal up what the seven thunders spoke, and do not write it down.”

before: And the angel whom I saw standing upon the sea and upon the earth raised his right hand to heaven,
after: And the angel whom I saw standing upon the sea and upon the earth raised his right hand to heaven,

before: and swore by the One living for the ages of the ages, who created heaven and the things in it, and the earth and the things in it, and the sea and the things in it, that there will be no more delay.
after: and swore by the One living for the ages of the ages, who created heaven and the things in it, and the earth and the things in it, and the sea and the things in it, that there will be no more delay.

before: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound, the mystery of God will be completed, as He announced the good news to His own slaves, the prophets.
after: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound, the mystery of God will be completed, as He announced the good news to His own slaves, the prophets.

before: And the voice that I heard from heaven spoke with me again, saying, “Go, take the opened scroll in the hand of the angel standing upon the sea and upon the earth.”
after: And the voice that I heard from heaven spoke with me again, saying, “Go, take the opened scroll in the hand of the angel standing upon the sea and upon the earth.”

before: And I went to the angel, telling him to give me the little scroll. And he saith unto me, “Take and devour it. It shall make thy belly bitter, but in thy mouth it shall be sweet as honey.”
after: And I went to the angel and told him to give me the little scroll. He says to me, “Take it and devour it. It will make your belly bitter, but in your mouth it will be sweet as honey.”

before: And I took the little scroll from the angel’s hand and devoured it, and in my mouth it was sweet as honey; and when I ate it, my belly was made bitter.
after: And I took the little scroll from the angel’s hand and devoured it. In my mouth it was sweet as honey, but when I ate it, my belly turned bitter.

before: And they say unto me, “Thou must prophesy again concerning peoples and nations and tongues and many kings.”
after: And they say to me, “You must prophesy again concerning peoples and nations and tongues and many kings.”

before: And a reed like a rod was given to me, with the words, “Rise and measure the temple of God and the altar and those worshipping in it.
after: And a reed like a rod was given to me, with the words, “Rise and measure the sanctuary of God and the altar and those who worship there.

before: And leave out the court outside the temple, and do not measure it, because it was given to the nations, and they will trample the holy city for forty-two months.
after: But leave out the court outside the sanctuary and do not measure it, for it was given to the nations, and they will trample the holy city for forty-two months.

before: And I will grant authority to My two witnesses, and they will prophesy for a thousand two hundred sixty days, clothed in sackcloth.”
after: And I will grant authority to My two witnesses, and they will prophesy for a thousand two hundred sixty days, clothed in sackcloth.”

before: These are the two olive trees and the two lampstands standing before the Lord of the earth.
after: These are the two olive trees and the two lampstands standing before the Lord of the earth.

before: And if anyone wisheth to harm them, fire cometh out of their mouth and devoureth their enemies; and if anyone should wish to harm them, in this way he must be killed.
after: And if anyone wishes to harm them, fire comes out of their mouth and devours their enemies. If anyone should wish to harm them, he must be killed in this way.

before: These have authority to shut heaven, so that rain may not fall during the days of their prophecy; and they have authority over the waters to turn them into blood and to strike the earth with every plague as often as they wish.
after: These have authority to shut heaven, so that rain may not fall during the days of their prophecy; and they have authority over the waters to turn them into blood and to strike the earth with every plague as often as they wish.

before: And when they complete their testimony, the beast coming up from the abyss will make war with them and conquer them and kill them.
after: And when they complete their testimony, the beast coming up from the abyss will make war with them and conquer them and kill them.

before: And their dead body lieth upon the broad street of the great city, which is spiritually called Sodom and Egypt, where also their Lord was crucified.
after: And their dead body lies in the broad street of the great city, which is called Sodom and Egypt in a spiritual sense, where their Lord also was crucified.

before: And people from the peoples and tribes and tongues and nations look at their dead body for three and a half days, and do not allow their dead bodies to be placed in a tomb.
after: And for three and a half days, some from the peoples and tribes and tongues and nations gaze upon their dead body, and do not allow their dead bodies to be laid in a tomb.

before: And those dwelling upon the earth rejoice over them and make merry, and will send gifts to one another, because these two prophets tormented those dwelling upon the earth.
after: And those who dwell upon the earth rejoice over them and make merry, and will send gifts to one another, for these two prophets tormented those who dwell upon the earth.

before: And after the three and a half days a spirit of life from God entered into them, and they stood upon their feet, and great fear fell upon those watching them.
after: And after the three and a half days a spirit of life from God entered them, and they stood upon their feet. Great fear fell upon those who watched them.

before: And they heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, “Come up here.” And they went up into heaven in the cloud, and their enemies watched them.
after: And they heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, “Come up here.” And they went up into heaven in the cloud, and their enemies looked on.

before: And in that hour a great earthquake occurred, and a tenth of the city fell, and seven thousand human names were killed in the earthquake; and the rest became fearful and gave glory to the God of heaven.
after: And in that hour there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell. Seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the rest were struck with fear and gave glory to the God of heaven.

before: The second woe hath passed. Behold, the third woe is coming quickly.
after: The second woe has passed. Behold, the third woe is coming swiftly.

before: And the seventh angel sounded, and loud voices arose in heaven, saying, “The kingdom of the world hath become the kingdom of our Lord and of His Christ, and He will reign for the ages of the ages.”
after: And the seventh angel sounded, and loud voices arose in heaven, saying, “The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of His Christ, and He shall reign for the ages of the ages.”

before: And the twenty-four elders sitting upon their thrones before God fell upon their faces and worshipped God,
after: And the twenty-four elders sitting upon their thrones before God fell upon their faces and worshipped God,

before: saying, “We give Thee thanks, Lord God Almighty, the One who is and who was, because Thou hast taken Thy great power and reigned.
after: saying, “We give Thee thanks, Lord God Almighty, the One who is and who was, for Thou hast taken Thy great power and begun to reign.

before: And the nations were enraged, and Thy wrath came, and the time for the dead to be judged, and to give the reward to Thy slaves the prophets and to the saints and to those who fear Thy name, the small and the great, and to destroy those destroying the earth.”
after: And the nations grew wrathful, and Thy wrath came, and the time came for the dead to be judged, to give the reward to Thy slaves the prophets and to the saints and to those who fear Thy name, the small and the great, and to destroy those who destroy the earth.”

before: And God’s temple in heaven was opened, and the ark of His covenant was seen in His temple; and there were lightnings and voices and thunders and an earthquake and great hail.
after: And the sanctuary of God in heaven was opened, and the ark of His covenant was seen in His sanctuary. Then came flashes of lightning and voices and thunders and an earthquake and great hail.

before: And a great sign was seen in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon beneath her feet, and upon her head a crown of twelve stars.
after: And a great sign was seen in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon beneath her feet, and upon her head a crown of twelve stars.

before: And she was pregnant, and crieth out in labour and torment to give birth.
after: And she was with child, and she cries out in travail and in the anguish of giving birth.

before: And another sign was seen in heaven, and behold, a great fiery red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his heads seven diadems.
after: And another sign was seen in heaven, and behold, a great fiery red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his heads seven diadems.

before: And his tail draggeth a third of the stars of heaven and threw them to the earth. And the dragon standeth before the woman about to give birth, so that when she giveth birth he may devour her child.
after: And his tail sweeps a third of the stars of heaven. It cast them upon the earth. And the dragon stands before the woman who is about to give birth, so that he may devour her child when she gives birth.

before: And she bore a son, a male, who is to shepherd all the nations with an iron rod; and her child was caught up to God and to His throne.
after: And she bore a son, a male, who is to shepherd all the nations with an iron rod; and her child was caught up to God and to His throne.

before: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she hath a place prepared by God, so that there they may nourish her for a thousand two hundred sixty days.
after: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared by God, so that there they may nourish her for a thousand two hundred sixty days.

before: And war arose in heaven: Michael and his angels were to wage war with the dragon. And the dragon and his angels fought,
after: And war arose in heaven: Michael and his angels were to wage war with the dragon. And the dragon and his angels fought,

before: and he did not prevail, nor was a place found for them any more in heaven.
after: and he did not prevail, nor was a place found for them any more in heaven.

before: And the great dragon was thrown down, the ancient serpent, who is called the Devil and Satan, the one deceiving the whole inhabited world; he was thrown to the earth, and his angels were thrown with him.
after: And the great dragon was cast down, the ancient serpent called the Devil and Satan, who deceives the whole inhabited world. He was cast upon the earth, and his angels were cast down with him.

before: And I heard a loud voice in heaven saying, “Now have come the salvation and the power and the kingdom of our God and the authority of His Christ, because the accuser of our brothers hath been thrown down, the one accusing them before our God day and night.
after: And I heard a loud voice in heaven saying, “Now have come the salvation and the power and the kingdom of our God and the authority of His Christ, for the accuser of our brothers has been cast down, the one who accuses them before our God day and night.

before: And they conquered him because of the blood of the Lamb and because of the word of their testimony, and they did not love their life until death.
after: And they conquered him because of the blood of the Lamb and because of the word of their testimony, and they did not love their life, even unto death.

before: For this reason rejoice, heavens and those dwelling in them. Woe to the earth and the sea, because the devil came down to you, having great fury, knowing that he hath a little time.”
after: Therefore rejoice, O heavens, and you who dwell in them. Woe to the earth and the sea, for the devil has come down to you in great fury, knowing that his time is short.”

before: And when the dragon saw that he had been thrown to the earth, he pursued the woman who bore the male child.
after: And when the dragon saw that he had been thrown to the earth, he pursued the woman who bore the male child.

before: And the two wings of the great eagle were given to the woman, so that she might fly into the wilderness to her place, where she is nourished for a time and times and half a time, away from the face of the serpent.
after: And the two wings of the great eagle were given to the woman, so that she might fly into the wilderness to her place, where she is nourished for a time and times and half a time, away from the face of the serpent.

before: And the serpent threw water like a river from his mouth after the woman, to make her swept away by the river.
after: And the serpent cast water like a river from his mouth after the woman, to sweep her away in the river.

before: And the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed the river that the dragon threw from his mouth.
after: And the earth helped the woman. The earth opened its mouth and swallowed the river that the dragon cast from his mouth.

before: And the dragon was enraged at the woman, and went away to make war with the rest of her offspring, those keeping the commandments of God and holding the testimony of Jesus.
after: And the dragon grew wrathful against the woman, and went away to make war with the rest of her offspring, those who keep the commandments of God and hold to the testimony of Jesus.

before: And he stood upon the sand of the sea.
after: And he stood upon the sand of the sea.

before: And I saw a beast coming up from the sea, having ten horns and seven heads, and upon its horns ten diadems, and upon its heads names of blasphemy.
after: And I saw a beast coming up from the sea, having ten horns and seven heads, and upon its horns ten diadems, and upon its heads names of blasphemy.

before: And the beast I saw was like a leopard, and its feet like a bear’s, and its mouth like a lion’s mouth. And the dragon gave it his power and his throne and great authority.
after: And the beast I saw was like a leopard, and its feet like a bear’s, and its mouth like a lion’s mouth. And the dragon gave it his power and his throne and great authority.

before: And one of its heads was as slaughtered to death, and its wound of death was healed. And the whole earth marvelled after the beast,
after: And I saw one of its heads as though slaughtered to death, and its mortal wound was healed. And the whole earth followed the beast in wonder,

before: and they worshipped the dragon because he gave authority to the beast, and they worshipped the beast, saying, “Who is like the beast, and who is able to wage war with it?”
after: and they worshipped the dragon because he gave authority to the beast, and they worshipped the beast, saying, “Who is like the beast, and who is able to wage war with it?”

before: And a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies was given to it, and authority to act for forty-two months was given to it.
after: And a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies was given to it, and authority to act for forty-two months was given to it.

before: And it opened its mouth in blasphemies against God, to blaspheme His name and His tent, those dwelling in heaven.
after: And it opened its mouth in blasphemies against God, to blaspheme His name and His tent, those who dwell in heaven.

before: And it was given to it to make war with the saints and conquer them, and authority was given to it over every tribe and people and tongue and nation.
after: And it was permitted to make war with the saints and conquer them, and authority was given to it over every tribe and people and tongue and nation.

before: And all those dwelling upon the earth will worship it, each whose name hath not been written in the book of life of the Lamb slaughtered from the foundation of the world.
after: And all who dwell upon the earth will worship it, each whose name has not been written in the book of life of the Lamb slaughtered from the foundation of the world.

before: If anyone hath an ear, let him hear.
after: If anyone has an ear, let him hear.

before: If anyone is for captivity, into captivity he goeth; if anyone is to be killed by a sword, by a sword he must be killed. Here is the endurance and the faith of the saints.
after: If anyone is for captivity, into captivity he goes. If anyone is to be killed by the sword, by the sword he must be killed. Here is the endurance and the faith of the saints.

before: And I saw another beast coming up from the earth, and it had two horns like a lamb, and spoke like a dragon.
after: And I saw another beast coming up from the earth. It had two horns like a lamb’s, and it spoke like a dragon.

before: And it exerciseth all the authority of the first beast before it, and maketh the earth and those dwelling in it worship the first beast, whose wound of death was healed.
after: And it exercises all the authority of the first beast in its presence, and makes the earth and those who dwell in it worship the first beast, whose mortal wound was healed.

before: And it performeth great signs, so that it even maketh fire come down from heaven to the earth before people.
after: And it performs great signs, even making fire come down from heaven to the earth in the sight of people.

before: And it deceiveth those dwelling upon the earth because of the signs it was given to perform before the beast, telling those dwelling upon the earth to make an image for the beast that hath the sword wound and lived.
after: And it deceives those who dwell upon the earth by reason of the signs it was given to perform in the presence of the beast, telling those who dwell upon the earth to make an image for the beast that bears the sword wound and lived.

before: And it was given to it to give breath to the beast’s image, so that the beast’s image might both speak and cause as many as would not worship the beast’s image to be killed.
after: And it was permitted to give breath to the beast’s image, so that the beast’s image might both speak and cause all who would not worship the beast’s image to be killed.

before: And it causeth all—the small and the great, and the rich and the poor, and the free and the slaves—to be given a mark upon their right hand or upon their forehead,
after: And it causes all, the small and the great, the rich and the poor, the free and the slaves, to receive a mark upon their right hand or upon their forehead,

before: so that no one may be able to buy or sell except the one having the mark, the name of the beast or the number of its name.
after: so that no one may be able to buy or sell except the one having the mark, the name of the beast or the number of its name.

before: Here is wisdom. Let the one who hath understanding calculate the number of the beast, for it is a human number, and its number is six hundred sixty-six.
after: Here is wisdom. Let the one who has understanding calculate the number of the beast, for it is a human number, and its number is six hundred sixty-six.

before: And I saw, and behold, the Lamb standing upon Mount Zion, and with Him a hundred forty-four thousand having His name and His Father’s name written upon their foreheads.
after: And I saw, and behold, the Lamb standing upon Mount Zion, and with Him a hundred forty-four thousand having His name and His Father’s name written upon their foreheads.

before: And I heard a voice from heaven like the sound of many waters and like the sound of great thunder; and the voice I heard was like lyre players playing on their lyres.
after: And I heard a voice from heaven like the sound of many waters and like the sound of great thunder. The voice I heard was like lyre players playing upon their lyres.

before: And they sing something like a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders; and no one was able to learn the song except the hundred forty-four thousand purchased from the earth.
after: And they sing something like a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders; and no one was able to learn the song except the hundred forty-four thousand purchased from the earth.

before: These are the ones who were not defiled with women, for they are virgins. These are the ones following the Lamb wherever He goeth. These were purchased from among people as firstfruits to God and to the Lamb,
after: These are the ones who were not defiled with women, for they are virgins. These are the ones who follow the Lamb wherever He goes. These were purchased from among people as firstfruits for God and for the Lamb,

before: and no lie was found in their mouth; they are unblemished.
after: and no lie was found in their mouth. They are unblemished.

before: And I saw another angel flying in midheaven, having eternal good news to proclaim to those seated upon the earth and to every nation and tribe and tongue and people,
after: And I saw another angel flying in midheaven, having eternal good news to proclaim to those seated upon the earth and to every nation and tribe and tongue and people,

before: saying in a loud voice, “Fear God and give Him glory, because the hour of His judgment hath come, and worship the One who made heaven and the earth and sea and springs of waters.”
after: saying with a loud voice, “Fear God and give Him glory, for the hour of His judgment has come. Worship the One who made heaven and the earth and the sea and the springs of water.”

before: And another, a second angel, followed, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, who hath made all the nations drink from the wine of the fury of her sexual immorality.”
after: And another angel, a second, followed, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, who has made all the nations drink of the wine of the fury of her fornication.”

before: And another angel, a third, followed them, saying in a loud voice, “If anyone worshippeth the beast and its image, and receiveth a mark upon his forehead or upon his hand,
after: And another angel, a third, followed them, saying with a loud voice, “If anyone worships the beast and its image and receives a mark upon his forehead or upon his hand,

before: he too will drink from the wine of God’s fury, prepared unmixed in the cup of His wrath, and will be tormented in fire and sulfur before holy angels and before the Lamb.
after: he too will drink from the wine of God’s fury, prepared unmixed in the cup of His wrath, and will be tormented in fire and sulfur before holy angels and before the Lamb.

before: And the smoke of their torment goeth up for ages of ages, and they have no rest day and night, those worshipping the beast and its image, and anyone who receiveth the mark of its name.”
after: And the smoke of their torment rises for ages of ages, and they have no rest day and night, those who worship the beast and its image, and anyone who receives the mark of its name.”

before: Here is the endurance of the saints, those keeping the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.
after: Here is the endurance of the saints, those keeping the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.

before: And I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Write: Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.” “Yea,” saith the Spirit, “so that they may rest from their labours, for their works follow with them.”
after: And I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Write: Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “that they may rest from their labours, for their works follow with them.”

before: And I saw, and behold, a white cloud, and upon the cloud One sitting like a son of man, having upon His head a golden crown and in His hand a sharp sickle.
after: And I saw, and behold, a white cloud, and upon the cloud One sitting like a son of man, having upon His head a golden crown and in His hand a sharp sickle.

before: And another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to the One sitting upon the cloud, “Send Thy sickle and reap, because the hour to reap hath come, because the harvest of the earth hath dried.”
after: And another angel came out of the sanctuary, crying with a loud voice to the One sitting upon the cloud, “Send forth Thy sickle and reap, for the hour to reap has come, for the harvest of the earth has dried.”

before: And the One sitting upon the cloud cast His sickle upon the earth, and the earth was reaped.
after: And the One sitting upon the cloud cast His sickle upon the earth, and the earth was reaped.

before: And another angel came out of the temple in heaven, himself also having a sharp sickle.
after: And another angel came out of the sanctuary in heaven, himself also having a sharp sickle.

before: And another angel came from the altar, the one having authority over the fire, and called with a loud voice to the one having the sharp sickle, saying, “Send thy sharp sickle and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth, because its grapes have ripened.”
after: And another angel came out from the altar, who had authority over the fire. He called with a loud voice to the one who had the sharp sickle, saying, “Send forth your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth, for its grapes have ripened.”

before: And the angel cast his sickle into the earth and gathered the vine of the earth, and threw it into the great winepress of God’s fury.
after: And the angel cast his sickle into the earth and harvested the vine of the earth, and cast it into the great winepress of God’s fury.

before: And the winepress was trodden outside the city, and blood came out of the winepress as far as the horses’ bridles, for a thousand six hundred stadia.
after: And the winepress was trodden outside the city, and blood came out of the winepress as far as the horses’ bridles, for a thousand six hundred stadia.

before: And I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvellous: seven angels having seven plagues, the last ones, because in them the fury of God was completed.
after: And I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvellous: seven angels bearing seven plagues, the last of all, for in them the fury of God was brought to its end.

before: And I saw something like a glassy sea mixed with fire, and those conquering the beast and its image and the number of its name standing upon the glassy sea, having lyres of God.
after: And I saw what was like a sea of glass mingled with fire. Those who had conquered the beast and its image and the number of its name stood upon the sea of glass, holding lyres of God.

before: And they sing the song of Moses, the slave of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvellous are Thy works, Lord God Almighty; righteous and true are Thy ways, O King of the nations.
after: And they sing the song of Moses, the slave of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvellous are Thy works, Lord God Almighty; righteous and true are Thy ways, O King of the nations.

before: Who shall not fear, Lord, and glorify Thy name, because Thou alone art holy? For all the nations shall come and worship before Thee, because Thy righteous acts have been manifested.”
after: Who shall not fear, O Lord, and glorify Thy name? For Thou alone art holy. For all the nations shall come and worship before Thee, for Thy righteous acts have been revealed.”

before: And after these things I saw, and the temple of the tent of the testimony in heaven was opened,
after: And after these things I looked, and the sanctuary of the tent of the testimony in heaven was opened,
