before: and the seven angels having the seven plagues came out of the temple, clothed in pure, bright linen and girded around their chests with golden belts.
after: and out of the sanctuary came the seven angels bearing the seven plagues, clothed in pure, bright linen, with golden sashes girded about their chests.

before: And one of the four living creatures gave the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the fury of God, who liveth for the ages of the ages.
after: And one of the four living creatures gave the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the fury of God, who lives for the ages of the ages.

before: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from His power, and no one was able to enter the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels were completed.
after: And the sanctuary was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from His power, and no one could enter the sanctuary until the seven plagues of the seven angels had run their course.

before: And I heard a loud voice from the temple saying to the seven angels, “Go and pour out the seven bowls of God’s fury into the earth.”
after: And I heard a loud voice from the sanctuary saying to the seven angels, “Go and pour out the seven bowls of God’s fury upon the earth.”

before: And the first went and poured out his bowl into the earth, and a bad and painful sore came upon the people having the mark of the beast and worshipping its image.
after: And the first went and poured out his bowl upon the earth, and a foul and grievous sore came upon those who bore the mark of the beast and worshipped its image.

before: And the second poured out his bowl into the sea, and it became blood like a dead person’s, and every living soul died, the things in the sea.
after: And the second poured out his bowl into the sea, and it became blood like that of a dead man. And every living creature in the sea died.

before: And the third poured out his bowl into the rivers and the springs of the waters, and they became blood.
after: And the third poured out his bowl into the rivers and the springs of water, and they became blood.

before: And I heard the angel of the waters saying, “Thou art righteous, the One who is and who was, the Holy One, because Thou didst judge these things.
after: And I heard the angel of the waters saying, “Righteous art Thou, who art and who wast, O Holy One, for Thou hast judged these things.

before: Because they poured out the blood of saints and prophets, Thou hast also given them blood to drink; they are worthy of it.”
after: For they poured out the blood of saints and prophets, and Thou hast given them blood to drink. They deserve it.”

before: And I heard the altar saying, “Yea, Lord God Almighty, true and righteous are Thy judgments.”
after: And I heard the altar saying, “Yes, Lord God Almighty, true and righteous are Thy judgments.”

before: And the fourth poured out his bowl upon the sun, and it was given to it to scorch people with fire.
after: And the fourth poured out his bowl upon the sun, and the sun was given power to scorch people with fire.

before: And people were scorched with great heat, and blasphemed the name of God, who hath authority over these plagues, and did not repent to give Him glory.
after: And the people were scorched with fierce heat, and they blasphemed the name of God, who has authority over these plagues. They did not repent and give Him glory.

before: And the fifth poured out his bowl upon the beast’s throne, and its kingdom became darkened, and they were chewing their tongues because of the pain,
after: And the fifth poured out his bowl upon the throne of the beast, and its kingdom was darkened. And they gnawed their tongues in pain,

before: and blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, and did not repent of their works.
after: and blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, and did not repent of their works.

before: And the sixth poured out his bowl upon the great river Euphrates, and its water was dried up, so that the way of the kings from the rising of the sun might be prepared.
after: And the sixth poured out his bowl upon the great river Euphrates, and its water was dried up, that the way might be prepared for the kings from the rising of the sun.

before: And I saw from the dragon’s mouth and from the beast’s mouth and from the false prophet’s mouth three unclean spirits like frogs.
after: And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs coming out of the mouth of the dragon and out of the mouth of the beast and out of the mouth of the false prophet.

before: For they are spirits of demons performing signs, which go out to the kings of the whole inhabited world to gather them for the war of the great day of God Almighty.
after: For they are spirits of demons that perform signs and go out to the kings of the whole inhabited world to gather them for the war of the great day of God Almighty.

before: “Behold, I am coming like a thief. Blessed is the one who watcheth and keepeth his garments, so that he may not walk naked and they see his shame.”
after: “Behold, I am coming like a thief. Blessed is he who stays awake and keeps his garments, lest he walk naked and his shame be seen.”

before: And they gathered them to the place called in Hebrew Harmagedon.
after: And they gathered them at the place called in Hebrew Harmagedon.

before: And the seventh poured out his bowl upon the air, and a loud voice came out of the temple from the throne, saying, “It hath happened.”
after: And the seventh poured out his bowl upon the air, and a loud voice came out of the sanctuary from the throne, saying, “It is done.”

before: And there were lightnings and voices and thunders, and a great earthquake occurred, such as had not occurred since human beings came to be upon the earth—so mighty an earthquake, so great.
after: And there were flashes of lightning and voices and peals of thunder. And there was a great earthquake, such as had never been since man came upon the earth, so mighty and so great was the earthquake.

before: And the great city became three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. And Babylon the great was remembered before God, to give her the cup of the wine of the fury of His wrath.
after: And the great city was split into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. And Babylon the Great was remembered before God, to give her the cup of the wine of the fury of His wrath.

before: And every island fled, and mountains were not found.
after: And every island fled, and no mountains were found.

before: And great hail, about a talent in weight, cometh down from heaven upon people; and people blasphemed God because of the plague of hail, because its plague is exceedingly great.
after: And great hailstones, about a talent in weight, come down from heaven upon the people. And the people blasphemed God because of the plague of hail, for its plague is exceedingly great.

before: And one of the seven angels having the seven bowls came and spoke with me, saying, “Come, I will show thee the judgment of the great prostitute sitting upon many waters,
after: And one of the seven angels who held the seven bowls came and spoke with me, saying, “Come, I will show you the judgment of the great harlot who sits upon many waters,

before: with whom the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality, and those dwelling on the earth became drunk from the wine of her sexual immorality.”
after: with whom the kings of the earth committed fornication, and with the wine of whose fornication the dwellers on the earth became drunk.”

before: And he carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness. And I saw a woman sitting upon a scarlet beast, full of names of blasphemy, having seven heads and ten horns.
after: And he carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness. And I saw a woman seated upon a scarlet beast, full of names of blasphemy, with seven heads and ten horns.

before: And the woman was clothed in purple and scarlet, and adorned with gold and precious stone and pearls, having in her hand a golden cup full of abominations and the unclean things of her sexual immorality.
after: And the woman was clothed in purple and scarlet, adorned with gold and precious stones and pearls. In her hand she held a golden cup full of abominations and the uncleanness of her fornication,

before: And upon her forehead a name was written, a mystery: “Babylon the great, the mother of prostitutes and of the abominations of the earth.”
after: and upon her forehead a name was written, a mystery: “Babylon the Great, the mother of harlots and of the abominations of the earth.”

before: And I saw the woman drunk from the blood of the saints and from the blood of the witnesses of Jesus. And seeing her, I marvelled with great amazement.
after: And I saw the woman drunk with the blood of the saints and with the blood of the witnesses of Jesus. And when I saw her, I was filled with wonder.

before: And the angel said unto me, “Why didst thou marvel? I will tell thee the mystery of the woman and of the beast carrying her, which hath the seven heads and the ten horns.
after: And the angel said to me, “Why did you marvel? I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her, which has the seven heads and the ten horns.

before: The beast thou sawest was and is not, and is about to come up from the abyss, and goeth into destruction. And those dwelling upon the earth, whose name hath not been written in the book of life from the foundation of the world, will marvel when they see the beast, because it was and is not and will be present.
after: The beast you saw was and is not, and is about to rise out of the abyss and goes to destruction. And the dwellers on the earth, whose names have not been written in the book of life from the foundation of the world, will marvel when they see the beast, for it was and is not and will be present.

before: Here is the mind that hath wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, upon which the woman sitteth, and they are seven kings.
after: Here is the mind that has wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains upon which the woman sits, and they are seven kings.

before: The five fell, the one is, the other hath not yet come, and whenever he cometh, he must remain a little while.
after: Five have fallen, one is, and the other has yet to come. When he comes, he must remain a little while.

before: And the beast that was and is not is itself also an eighth, and is from the seven, and goeth into destruction.
after: And the beast that was and is not is itself an eighth, and is of the seven, and goes to destruction.

before: And the ten horns thou sawest are ten kings, who have not yet received a kingdom, but receive authority as kings for one hour with the beast.
after: And the ten horns you saw are ten kings who have yet to receive a kingdom, but receive authority as kings for one hour with the beast.

before: These have one purpose, and give their power and authority to the beast.
after: These are of one purpose, and they give their power and authority to the beast.

before: These will wage war with the Lamb, and the Lamb will conquer them, because He is Lord of lords and King of kings, and those with Him are called and chosen and faithful.”
after: These will wage war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will conquer them, for He is Lord of lords and King of kings. And those with Him are called and chosen and faithful.”

before: And he saith unto me, “The waters thou sawest, where the prostitute sitteth, are peoples and multitudes and nations and tongues.
after: And he says to me, “The waters you saw, where the harlot sits, are peoples and multitudes and nations and tongues.

before: And the ten horns thou sawest and the beast, these will hate the prostitute and make her desolate and naked, and eat her flesh and burn her up with fire.
after: And the ten horns you saw and the beast will hate the harlot and make her desolate and naked. They will eat her flesh and burn her up with fire.

before: For God put it into their hearts to do His purpose, and to do one purpose and give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God are completed.
after: For God put it into their hearts to carry out His purpose, to act with one purpose and give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God are fulfilled.

before: And the woman thou sawest is the great city having kingship over the kings of the earth.”
after: And the woman you saw is the great city that holds kingship over the kings of the earth.”

before: After these things I saw another angel coming down from heaven, having great authority, and the earth was illuminated from his glory.
after: After these things I saw another angel coming down from heaven with great authority, and the earth was lit by his glory.

before: And he cried with a mighty voice, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, and she became a dwelling of demons and a prison of every unclean spirit and a prison of every unclean bird and a prison of every unclean and hated beast,
after: And he cried with a mighty voice, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the Great! She has become a dwelling for demons, a prison for every unclean spirit, a prison for every unclean bird, and a prison for every unclean and hated beast,

before: because all the nations have drunk from the wine of the fury of her sexual immorality, and the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality with her, and the merchants of the earth became rich from the power of her luxury.”
after: for all the nations have drunk of the wine of the fury of her fornication, and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth have grown rich through the power of her luxury.”

before: And I heard another voice from heaven saying, “Come out of her, My people, that ye may not share in her sins and may not receive from her plagues,
after: And I heard another voice from heaven saying, “Come out of her, My people, lest you share in her sins and receive of her plagues,

before: because her sins have piled up as far as heaven, and God remembered her wrongdoings.
after: for her sins have heaped up to heaven, and God has remembered her wrongs.

before: Repay her as she also repaid, and double the double according to her works; in the cup in which she mixed, mix a double portion for her.
after: Repay her as she repaid, and pay her double for her works. In the cup in which she mixed, mix a double portion for her.

before: As much as she glorified herself and lived in luxury, so much torment and mourning give her, because in her heart she saith, ‘I sit a queen, and I am not a widow, and I will certainly not see mourning.’
after: As much as she glorified herself and lived in luxury, so much torment and mourning give her. For in her heart she says, ‘I sit as queen. I am no widow, and I shall never see mourning.’

before: For this reason in one day her plagues will come, death and mourning and famine, and she will be burned up with fire, because the Lord God who judged her is mighty.”
after: Therefore in one day her plagues shall come, death and mourning and famine, and she shall be burned up with fire, for mighty is the Lord God who has judged her.”

before: And the kings of the earth who committed sexual immorality and lived in luxury with her will weep and mourn over her when they see the smoke of her burning,
after: And the kings of the earth who committed fornication and lived in luxury with her shall weep and lament over her when they see the smoke of her burning,

before: standing far away because of the fear of her torment, saying, “Woe, woe, the great city, Babylon, the mighty city, because in one hour thy judgment came!”
after: standing far off for fear of her torment and saying, “Woe, woe, O great city, Babylon, mighty city! For in one hour your judgment has come.”

before: And the merchants of the earth weep and mourn over her, because no one buyeth their cargo any more:
after: And the merchants of the earth weep and mourn over her, for no one buys their cargo any more:

before: cargo of gold and silver and precious stone and pearls and fine linen and purple and silk and scarlet, and every fragrant wood and every ivory vessel and every vessel of most precious wood and bronze and iron and marble,
after: cargo of gold and silver and precious stones and pearls, of fine linen and purple and silk and scarlet, of every kind of thyine wood and every vessel of ivory and every vessel of costly wood and bronze and iron and marble,

before: and cinnamon and amomum and incense and ointment and frankincense and wine and oil and fine flour and wheat and cattle and sheep, and horses and carriages and slaves—human lives.
after: and cinnamon and amomum and incense and ointment and frankincense and wine and oil and fine flour and wheat and cattle and sheep, and horses and carriages and slaves—human lives.

before: And the fruit thy soul desired went away from thee, and all the rich and splendid things perished from thee, and they will certainly not find them any more.
after: And the fruit your soul longed for has gone from you, and all your rich and splendid things have perished, and never again shall they find them.

before: The merchants of these things, who became rich from her, will stand far away because of fear of her torment, weeping and mourning,
after: The merchants of these things, who grew rich from her, shall stand far off for fear of her torment, weeping and mourning

before: saying, “Woe, woe, the great city, clothed in fine linen and purple and scarlet and adorned with gold and precious stone and pearl,
after: and saying, “Woe, woe, O great city, clothed in fine linen and purple and scarlet, adorned with gold and precious stones and pearls!

before: because in one hour so great a wealth was made desolate!” And every helmsman and everyone sailing from place to place, and sailors and as many as work the sea, stood far away,
after: For in one hour such great wealth has been laid waste!” And every helmsman and everyone who sails from place to place, the sailors and all who make their living by the sea, stood far off,

before: and cried as they saw the smoke of her burning, saying, “What is like the great city?”
after: and cried out when they saw the smoke of her burning, saying, “What city is like the great city?”

before: And they threw dust upon their heads and cried, weeping and mourning, saying, “Woe, woe, the great city, in which all who had ships in the sea became rich from her costly wealth, because in one hour she was made desolate!”
after: And they cast dust upon their heads and cried out, weeping and mourning, “Woe, woe, O great city! In her all who had ships at sea grew rich from her costly wealth, for in one hour she has been laid waste!”

before: Rejoice over her, heaven and saints and apostles and prophets, because God hath judged your case against her.
after: Rejoice over her, O heaven, and you saints and apostles and prophets, for God has judged your case against her.

before: And one mighty angel lifted a stone like a great millstone and threw it into the sea, saying, “In this way Babylon the great city will be thrown with a rush, and will certainly not be found any more.
after: And a mighty angel lifted a stone like a great millstone and cast it into the sea, saying, “So shall Babylon, the great city, be hurled down with violence, and never again shall she be found.

before: And the sound of lyre players and musicians and flute players and trumpeters will certainly not be heard in thee any more, and any craftsman of any craft will certainly not be found in thee any more, and the sound of a mill will certainly not be heard in thee any more,
after: And the sound of lyre players and musicians and flute players and trumpeters shall never again be heard in you, and no craftsman of any craft shall ever again be found in you, and the sound of a mill shall never again be heard in you,

before: and the light of a lamp will certainly not shine in thee any more, and the voice of bridegroom and bride will certainly not be heard in thee any more, because thy merchants were the great ones of the earth, because by thy sorcery all the nations were deceived.
after: and the light of a lamp shall never again shine in you, and the voice of bridegroom and bride shall never again be heard in you. For your merchants were the great ones of the earth, for by your sorcery all the nations were led astray.

before: And in her was found blood of prophets and saints and of all those slaughtered upon the earth.”
after: And in her was found the blood of prophets and saints and of all who were slaughtered upon the earth.”

before: After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! The salvation and the glory and the power belong to our God,
after: After these things I heard what seemed to be the loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation and glory and power belong to our God,

before: because His judgments are true and righteous, because He judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth by her sexual immorality, and avenged the blood of His slaves from her hand.”
after: for true and righteous are His judgments. For He has judged the great harlot who corrupted the earth with her fornication, and has avenged the blood of His slaves at her hand.”

before: And a second time they said, “Hallelujah! And her smoke goeth up for the ages of the ages.”
after: And a second time they said, “Hallelujah! And her smoke rises for the ages of the ages.”

before: And the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell and worshipped God, who sitteth upon the throne, saying, “Amen, Hallelujah!”
after: And the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshipped God who sits upon the throne, saying, “Amen! Hallelujah!”

before: And a voice came out from the throne, saying, “Praise our God, all His slaves and those who fear Him, the small and the great.”
after: And a voice came out from the throne, saying, “Praise our God, all His slaves and those who fear Him, the small and the great.”

before: And I heard something like a voice of a great multitude, and like a sound of many waters, and like a sound of mighty thunders, saying, “Hallelujah, because the Lord God Almighty hath reigned.
after: And I heard what seemed to be the voice of a great multitude, and the sound of many waters, and the sound of mighty thunder, saying, “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God, the Almighty, has taken up His reign.

before: Let us rejoice and exult, and we will give Him the glory, because the marriage of the Lamb hath come, and His wife prepared herself.
after: Let us rejoice and exult and give Him glory, for the marriage of the Lamb has come, and His bride has made herself ready.

before: And it was given to her to clothe herself in fine linen, bright and pure, for the fine linen is the righteous acts of the saints.”
after: And it was given to her to clothe herself in fine linen, bright and pure, for the fine linen is the righteous acts of the saints.”

before: And he saith unto me, “Write: Blessed are those called to the supper of the Lamb’s marriage.” And he saith unto me, “These are true words of God.”
after: And he says to me, “Write: Blessed are those who have been called to the marriage supper of the Lamb.” And he says to me, “These are the true words of God.”

before: And I fell before his feet to worship him. And he saith unto me, “See that thou do it not! I am thy fellow slave and of thy brothers who hold the testimony of Jesus. Worship God, for the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.”
after: And I fell at his feet to worship him. And he says to me, “See that you do not! I am a fellow slave with you and with your brothers who hold the testimony of Jesus. Worship God, for the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.”

before: And I saw heaven opened, and behold, a white horse, and the One sitting upon it is called Faithful and True, and in righteousness He judgeth and wageth war.
after: And I saw heaven opened, and behold, a white horse! And He who sat upon it is called Faithful and True, and in righteousness He judges and wages war.

before: And His eyes are a flame of fire, and upon His head are many diadems, having a name written that no one knoweth except Himself.
after: His eyes are like a flame of fire, and upon His head are many diadems. He has a name written that no one knows but Himself.

before: And He is clothed in a garment dipped in blood, and His name is called the Word of God.
after: And He is clothed in a garment dipped in blood, and His name is called the Word of God.

before: And the armies in heaven were following Him upon white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and pure.
after: And the armies in heaven followed Him upon white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and pure.

before: And from His mouth cometh out a sharp sword, so that with it He may strike the nations; and He will shepherd them with an iron rod, and He treadeth the winepress of the wine of the fury of the wrath of God Almighty.
after: And from His mouth comes a sharp sword with which to strike the nations. And He Himself shall shepherd them with a rod of iron, and He Himself treads the winepress of the wine of the fury of the wrath of God Almighty.

before: And upon the garment and upon His thigh He hath a name written: “King of kings and Lord of lords.”
after: And upon His garment and upon His thigh He has a name written: “King of kings and Lord of lords.”

before: And I saw one angel standing in the sun, and he cried with a loud voice, saying to all the birds flying in midheaven, “Come, gather for the great supper of God,
after: And I saw an angel standing in the sun, and he cried with a loud voice to all the birds flying in midheaven, “Come, gather for the great supper of God,

before: that ye may eat flesh of kings and flesh of commanders of thousands and flesh of mighty ones and flesh of horses and of those sitting upon them, and flesh of all, both free and slaves and small and great.”
after: that you may eat the flesh of kings and the flesh of commanders of thousands and the flesh of the mighty and the flesh of horses and their riders, and the flesh of all, free and slave, small and great.”

before: And I saw the beast and the kings of the earth and their armies gathered to wage war with the One sitting upon the horse and with His army.
after: And I saw the beast and the kings of the earth and their armies gathered to wage war against Him who sat upon the horse and against His army.

before: And the beast was seized, and with it the false prophet who performed the signs before it, by which he deceived those receiving the beast’s mark and those worshipping its image. The two were thrown alive into the lake of fire burning with sulfur.
after: And the beast was seized, and with it the false prophet who performed the signs before it, by which he led astray those who received the mark of the beast and those who worshipped its image. The two were cast alive into the lake of fire burning with sulfur.

before: And the rest were killed with the sword of the One sitting upon the horse, the sword coming out of His mouth, and all the birds were filled with their flesh.
after: And the rest were slain with the sword of Him who sat upon the horse, the sword that came out of His mouth, and all the birds were filled with their flesh.

before: And I saw an angel coming down from heaven, having the key of the abyss and a great chain upon his hand.
after: And I saw an angel coming down from heaven with the key of the abyss and a great chain in his hand.

before: And he seized the dragon, the ancient serpent, who is the Devil and Satan, and bound him for a thousand years,
after: And he seized the dragon, the ancient serpent, who is the Devil and Satan, and bound him for a thousand years,

before: and threw him into the abyss, and shut it and sealed it over him, so that he might no longer deceive the nations until the thousand years were completed. After these things he must be loosed for a little time.
after: and cast him into the abyss and shut it and sealed it over him, so that he might lead the nations astray no more until the thousand years were fulfilled. After these things he must be loosed for a little while.

before: And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given to them; and the souls of those beheaded because of the testimony of Jesus and because of the word of God, and those who did not worship the beast or its image and did not receive the mark upon their forehead and upon their hand. And they lived and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.
after: And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given to them. And I saw the souls of those beheaded for the testimony of Jesus and for the word of God, and those who had not worshipped the beast or its image and had not received its mark upon their forehead or upon their hand. And they came to life and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.

before: The rest of the dead did not live until the thousand years were completed. This is the first resurrection.
after: The rest of the dead did not come to life until the thousand years were fulfilled. This is the first resurrection.

before: Blessed and holy is the one who hath a share in the first resurrection; over these the second death hath no authority, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and will reign with Him for a thousand years.
after: Blessed and holy is he who has a share in the first resurrection. Over these the second death has no authority, but they shall be priests of God and of Christ, and shall reign with Him for the thousand years.

before: And when the thousand years are completed, Satan will be loosed from his prison,
after: And when the thousand years are fulfilled, Satan shall be loosed from his prison,

before: and will go out to deceive the nations at the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them for war, whose number is like the sand of the sea.
after: and shall go out to lead astray the nations at the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them for war. Their number is as the sand of the sea.

before: And they came up upon the breadth of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city. And fire came down from heaven and devoured them.
after: And they went up over the breadth of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city. And fire came down from heaven and devoured them.

before: And the devil who deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, where also are the beast and the false prophet, and they will be tormented day and night for the ages of the ages.
after: And the Devil who led them astray was cast into the lake of fire and sulfur, where also are the beast and the false prophet, and they shall be tormented day and night for the ages of the ages.

before: And I saw a great white throne and the One sitting upon it, from whose face the earth and heaven fled, and no place was found for them.
after: And I saw a great white throne and Him who sat upon it. From His face earth and heaven fled, and no place was found for them.

before: And I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and scrolls were opened; and another scroll was opened, which is of life. And the dead were judged from the things written in the scrolls, according to their works.
after: And I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and books were opened. And another book was opened, which is the book of life. And the dead were judged by what was written in the books, according to their works.

before: And the sea gave the dead in it, and Death and Hades gave the dead in them, and they were judged, each according to their works.
after: And the sea gave up the dead that were in it, and Death and Hades gave up the dead that were in them, and they were judged, each according to his works.

before: And Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death, the lake of fire.
after: And Death and Hades were cast into the lake of fire. This is the second death, the lake of fire.

before: And if anyone was not found written in the book of life, he was thrown into the lake of fire.
after: And if anyone was not found written in the book of life, he was cast into the lake of fire.

before: And I saw a new heaven and a new earth; for the first heaven and the first earth passed away, and the sea is no more.
after: And I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth had passed away, and the sea was no more.

before: And I saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.
after: And I saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.

before: And I heard a great voice from the throne, saying, “Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men, and He shall dwell with them, and they shall be His peoples, and God Himself shall be with them as their God,
after: And I heard a loud voice from the throne, saying, “Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men, and He shall dwell with them, and they shall be His peoples, and God Himself shall be with them as their God,

before: and He shall wipe away every tear from their eyes, and death shall be no more; neither mourning nor crying nor pain shall be any more, for the former things passed away.”
after: and He shall wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death shall be no more, and mourning and crying and pain shall be no more, for the former things have passed away.”

before: And the One sitting upon the throne said, “Behold, I make all things new.” And He saith, “Write, because these words are faithful and true.”
after: And He who sits upon the throne said, “Behold, I make all things new.” And He says, “Write, for these words are faithful and true.”

before: And He said unto me, “They have come to be. I am the Alpha and the Omega, the beginning and the end. To the one who thirsteth I will give freely from the spring of the water of life.
after: And He said to me, “They have come to pass. I am the Alpha and the Omega, the beginning and the end. To him who thirsts I will give freely from the spring of the water of life.

before: The one who conquereth will inherit these things, and I will be his God and he will be My son.
after: He who conquers shall inherit these things, and I shall be his God and he shall be My son.

before: But as for the cowardly and unbelieving and abominable and murderers and sexually immoral and sorcerers and idolaters and all liars, their share is in the lake burning with fire and sulfur, which is the second death.”
after: But the cowardly and the unbelieving, the abominable and murderers and fornicators and sorcerers and idolaters and all liars, their share is in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur, which is the second death.”

before: And one of the seven angels having the seven bowls full of the seven last plagues came and spoke with me, saying, “Come, I will show thee the bride, the wife of the Lamb.”
after: And one of the seven angels who held the seven bowls full of the seven last plagues came and spoke with me, saying, “Come, I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb.”

before: And he carried me away in the Spirit upon a great and high mountain, and showed me the holy city Jerusalem coming down out of heaven from God,
after: And he carried me away in the Spirit to a great and high mountain and showed me the holy city Jerusalem coming down out of heaven from God,

before: having the glory of God. Her radiance was like a most precious stone, like a jasper stone shining as crystal,
after: bearing the glory of God. Her radiance was like a most precious stone, like jasper gleaming like crystal.

before: having a great and high wall, having twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names inscribed, which are those of the twelve tribes of the sons of Israel.
after: She had a great and high wall with twelve gates, and at the gates were twelve angels and inscribed names, which are those of the twelve tribes of the sons of Israel.

before: From the east, three gates; and from the north, three gates; and from the south, three gates; and from the west, three gates.
after: On the east were three gates, and on the north three gates, and on the south three gates, and on the west three gates.

before: And the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and upon them twelve names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
after: And the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and upon them twelve names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.

before: And the one speaking with me had a golden measuring reed, to measure the city and its gates and its wall.
after: And he who spoke with me held a golden reed for a measure, to measure the city and its gates and its wall.

before: And the city lieth foursquare, and its length is as great as its width. And he measured the city with the reed at twelve thousand stadia; its length and width and height are equal.
after: And the city lies foursquare, its length as great as its breadth. And he measured the city with the reed at twelve thousand stadia. Its length and breadth and height are equal.

before: And he measured its wall at a hundred forty-four cubits, a human measure, which is an angel’s.
after: And he measured its wall at a hundred and forty-four cubits by human measure, which is also the angel’s measure.

before: And the construction of its wall was jasper, and the city pure gold like pure glass.
after: And its wall was built of jasper, and the city was pure gold, like pure glass.

before: The foundations of the wall of the city were adorned with every precious stone: the first foundation jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,
after: The foundations of the wall of the city were adorned with every precious stone: the first foundation jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,

before: the fifth sardonyx, the sixth sardius, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh hyacinth, the twelfth amethyst.
after: the fifth sardonyx, the sixth sardius, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh hyacinth, the twelfth amethyst.

before: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls; each one of the gates was from one pearl. And the broad street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass.
after: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls, each gate made of a single pearl. And the broad street of the city was pure gold, like clear glass.

before: And I saw no temple therein, for the Lord God Almighty is its temple, and the Lamb.
after: And I saw no sanctuary in it, for the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are its sanctuary.

before: And the city hath no need of the sun or the moon to shine upon it, for the glory of God illuminated it, and its lamp is the Lamb.
after: And the city has no need of the sun or the moon to shine upon it, for the glory of God has lit it, and its lamp is the Lamb.

before: And the nations will walk through its light, and the kings of the earth bring their glory into it.
after: And the nations shall walk by its light, and the kings of the earth bring their glory into it.

before: And its gates will certainly not be shut by day, for there will be no night there,
after: And its gates shall never be shut by day, for there shall be no night there,

before: and they will bring the glory and the honour of the nations into it.
after: and they will bring the glory and the honour of the nations into it.

before: And nothing common, and no one practicing abomination and falsehood, will ever enter it, but only those written in the Lamb’s book of life.
after: And nothing profane shall ever enter it, nor anyone who does what is abominable or false, but only those whose names are written in the Lamb’s book of life.

before: And he showed me a river of water of life, bright as crystal, coming out of the throne of God and of the Lamb,
after: And he showed me a river of the water of life, bright as crystal, flowing out from the throne of God and of the Lamb,

before: in the middle of its broad street. And on this side and that side of the river was a tree of life bearing twelve fruits, yielding its fruit each month; and the leaves of the tree are for the healing of the nations.
after: down the middle of its broad street. And on either side of the river was the tree of life, bearing twelve crops of fruit, yielding its fruit each month. And the leaves of the tree are for the healing of the nations.

before: And no accursed thing will be any more. And the throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and His slaves will serve Him,
after: And there shall no longer be anything accursed. And the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it, and His slaves shall serve Him,

before: and they will see His face, and His name will be upon their foreheads.
after: and they shall see His face, and His name shall be upon their foreheads.

before: And night will be no more, and they have no need of lamplight and sunlight, because the Lord God will shine upon them, and they will reign for the ages of the ages.
after: And night shall be no more. They have no need of lamplight or sunlight, for the Lord God shall shine upon them, and they shall reign for the ages of the ages.

before: And he said unto me, “These words are faithful and true, and the Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, sent His angel to show His slaves the things that must take place soon.”
after: And he said to me, “These words are faithful and true, and the Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, sent His angel to show His slaves what must take place soon.”

before: “And behold, I am coming quickly. Blessed is the one who keepeth the words of the prophecy of this scroll.”
after: “And behold, I am coming quickly. Blessed is he who keeps the words of the prophecy of this scroll.”

before: And I, John, am the one hearing and seeing these things. And when I heard and saw, I fell to worship before the feet of the angel showing me these things.
after: And I, John, am he who hears and sees these things. And when I heard and saw them, I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who showed them to me.

before: And he saith unto me, “See that thou do it not! I am thy fellow slave and of thy brothers the prophets and of those keeping the words of this scroll. Worship God.”
after: And he says to me, “See that you do not! I am a fellow slave with you and with your brothers the prophets and with those who keep the words of this scroll. Worship God.”

before: And he saith unto me, “Do not seal the words of the prophecy of this scroll, for the time is near.
after: And he says to me, “Do not seal up the words of the prophecy of this scroll, for the time is near.

before: Let the one doing wrong do wrong still, and let the filthy one be filthy still, and let the righteous one do righteousness still, and let the holy one be sanctified still.”
after: Let him who does wrong do wrong still, and let the filthy be filthy still. Let the righteous do righteousness still, and let the holy be made holy still.”

before: “Behold, I am coming quickly, and My reward is with Me, to repay each according to what his work is.
after: “Behold, I am coming quickly, and My reward is with Me, to repay each according to his work.

before: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.”
after: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.”

before: Blessed are they who wash their robes, that they may have right to the tree of life and may enter through the gates into the city.
after: Blessed are those who wash their robes, that they may have the right to the tree of life and may enter the city through the gates.

before: Outside are the dogs and the sorcerers and the sexually immoral and the murderers and the idolaters and everyone loving and practicing falsehood.
after: Outside are the dogs and the sorcerers and the fornicators and the murderers and the idolaters and everyone who loves and practises falsehood.

before: “I, Jesus, sent My angel to testify these things to you for the Churches. I am the Root and the offspring of David, the bright morning star.”
after: “I, Jesus, sent My angel to testify to you of these things for the Churches. I am the Root and the offspring of David, the bright morning star.”

before: And the Spirit and the bride say, “Come.” And let the one who heareth say, “Come.” And let the one who thirsteth come; let the one who wisheth take water of life freely.
after: And the Spirit and the bride say, “Come.” And let him who hears say, “Come.” And let him who thirsts come. Let him who desires it take the water of life freely.

before: I testify to everyone who heareth the words of the prophecy of this scroll: if anyone addeth to them, God will add to him the plagues written in this scroll.
after: I testify to everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this scroll: if anyone adds to them, God shall add to him the plagues written in this scroll.

before: And if anyone taketh away from the words of the scroll of this prophecy, God will take away his share from the tree of life and from the holy city, the things written in this scroll.
after: And if anyone takes away from the words of the scroll of this prophecy, God shall take away his share in the tree of life and in the holy city, which are written of in this scroll.

before: The One testifying these things saith, “Yea, I am coming quickly.” Amen. Come, Lord Jesus.
after: He who testifies to these things says, “Yes, I am coming quickly.” Amen. Come, Lord Jesus.

before: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all.
after: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all.
